title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE LICENSING OF VESSELS ENGAGING IN THE COASTWISE TRADE AND VESSELS ENGAGING EXCLUSIVELY IN THE LIGHTERAGE AND HARBOR BUSINESS IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, AND FIXING THE LICENSE FEES THEREFOR.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE LICENSING OF VESSELS ENGAGING IN THE COASTWISE TRADE AND VESSELS ENGAGING EXCLUSIVELY IN THE LIGHTERAGE AND HARBOR BUSINESS IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS, AND FIXING THE LICENSE FEES THEREFOR.

text.en:
All vessels of the class designated in section one hundred and seventeen of Act Numbered Three
hundred and fifty-five, as amended by Act Numbered Twelve, hundred and thirty-five, of the Philippine
Commission, shall, prior to engaging in the coastwise trade, and annually thereafter, take out a license
therefor. This license shall be issued by collectors of customs at ports of entry, and the following fees shall be
charged therefor:
a. For vessels propelled by steam or other mechanical motive power, one peso and fifty
centavos, Philippine currency, per registered net ton;
b. For sailing vessels and vessels not propelled by steam or other mechanical motive power,
one peso, Philippine currency, per registered net ton.
